definition_zh: 系住（绳索）；固定；（攀登）保护；（航海口令）停住
definition_en: to fasten a rope around a cleat or pin; to secure a climber with a rope; a nautical command to stop
core_image: 绳索在系缆栓上绕出一个8字，纹丝不动
scene: 伙伴翻过岩檐，把绳索牢牢绕上保护站。She belayed the rope through the anchor before her partner climbed.
sceneCN: 这里 belayed 是「系住绳索」（第 1 个义项：把绳固定在栓、锚点等处）；句意是她在同伴攀爬前先把绳子系上保护站。

derivatives.zh: 由 belay 加 -ing 复合 pin 构成，义为「系索栓」

senses.title: To fasten a rope
senses.definition: to make a rope fast by winding it round a cleat, pin or anchor
senses.definitionCN: 把绳绕在系缆栓、木栓或锚点上固定
senses.example: She belayed the rope through the anchor before her partner climbed.
senses.exampleCN: 她在同伴攀爬前先把绳子系上保护站。
senses.why: The Old English root meant to encircle, and the rope is encircled round the pin.
senses.whyCN: 古英语词根本义「环绕」，绳索正是环绕在栓上。

senses.title: To secure a climber
senses.definition: in climbing, to hold the rope for a partner against falls
senses.definitionCN: 攀登运动中握绳保护同伴以防坠落
senses.example: He belayed patiently while his partner worked the overhang.
senses.exampleCN: 同伴攀越仰角时他耐心地做保护。
senses.why: Holding the rope fast grew into guarding the person on its other end.
senses.whyCN: 由「把绳固定」引申为「守护绳另一端的人」。

senses.title: A command to stop
senses.definition: a nautical command to stop or cease, now also jocular in general use
senses.definitionCN: 航海口令「停！」，如今也作戏谑的日常用语
senses.example: Belay that chatter and get back to work.
senses.why: Making a rope fast means stopping it, so the command ordered any action to cease.
senses.whyCN: 固定绳索即令其停止，口令由此泛化为「停止任何动作」。

intro.en: Belay comes from Old English leccan, to encircle.
intro.cn: belay 源自古英语 leccan「环绕」。

items.en: leccan is generally traced as meaning to encircle or wind; the evidence is partial.
items.cn: 古英语 leccan 一般认为意为「环绕、缠绕」，证据尚不完整。

items.en: belay meant to surround or overlay.
items.cn: 中古英语 belay 意为「环绕、覆盖」。

items.en: sailors used belay for fastening ropes to pins.
items.cn: 十六世纪水手用 belay 表示把绳系上木栓。

items.en: Belay! became the command to stop an action.
items.cn: Belay! 成为叫停动作的口令。

items.en: climbers adopted the word for rope protection, and belay that survives as slang.
items.cn: 登山者借词指保护绳技术，belay that 亦留存为俚语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or near spellings; the near-meaning group gathers fastening and stopping words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或近似拼写；近义组汇集固定与停止类词。

entries.definition: to pass along, or a race of exchanged runners
entries.definitionCN: 接力；转播——只是拼写相近，词义方向相反
耽搁——只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to act as a friend to
entries.definitionCN: 善待——同用 be- 前缀的动词

entries.definition: to secure a ship with ropes

normalIntro.en: Belay is be- plus lay: lay the rope round the pin.
normalIntro.cn: belay 是 be- 加 lay：把绳绕上木栓。

normal.en: Belay a rope means to make it fast.
normal.cn: belay a rope 意为把绳系牢。

normal.en: A belaying pin is the sailor's wooden peg.
normal.cn: belaying pin 是水手的系索木栓。
登山者使用保护器（belay device）。

normal.en: Belay that order means cancel it.
normal.cn: belay that order 意为撤销命令。

normal.en: Compare delay and relay for the spelling.
normal.cn: 拼写上比较 delay 与 relay。

abstract.en: See the rope cross over itself in a neat figure.
abstract.cn: 看绳索交叠出整齐的八字。

abstract.en: Feel the jerk of a fall travel down to your braced hands.
abstract.cn: 感受坠落的冲击传到绷紧的双手。

abstract.en: Hear the mate's shout freeze the deck.
abstract.cn: 听水手长的吼声让全甲板瞬间静止。

examples.en: She belayed the rope through the anchor before her partner climbed.
examples.cn: 她在同伴攀爬前先把绳子系上保护站。

examples.en: He belayed patiently while his partner worked the overhang.
examples.cn: 同伴攀越仰角时他耐心地做保护。

examples.en: Belay that chatter and get back to work.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「比·勒」——比谁勒得更紧，绳子一勒住就「固定不动」。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「使、围绕」）加 leccan（古英语，一般认为是「环绕、缠绕」，证据不全）；中古英语 belay 意为「环绕、覆盖」，十六世纪起专用于航海「系绳」，再引申出登山保护义与「停止」口令义。

sensesIntro.en: One word ties a rope, guards a climber, and barks stop on deck.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个词，既能系紧绳索、守护攀者，也能在甲板上一声断喝「停」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope wound tight in a figure round a pin.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳索在木栓上绕出紧实的八字。

intro.en: Belay pairs be- with an old root of encircling.
intro.cn: belay 把 be- 与古老的「环绕」词根配对。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根为古英语。

derivatives.zh: 由 belay 加 -ing 复合 pin 构成，义为「系索栓」
